summary.zh-CN: 青少年发现局限皮下肿物，临床记录较少；通过切除标本、组织形态和免疫组化形成有边界的判断与随访计划。
summary.en: An adolescent has a localised subcutaneous mass with a limited clinical record; integrate the specimen, morphology and immunohistochemistry into a bounded interpretation and follow-up plan.

notes.zh-CN: 依据已发表病例改写。保留年龄、性别和临床证据；姓名为化名，医院、日历日期、职业身份细节已去除。对话、问题、评分和安全选项为教学设计，未记录的数据明确未知。

text.zh-CN: 病变呈模糊结节或分叶状，血管较多，黏液样间质内散在梭形细胞，伴少量中性粒细胞浸润。
text.en: The lesion has indistinct nodular/lobulated architecture, numerous vessels and scattered spindle cells in myxoid stroma, with some neutrophilic infiltration.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 梭形细胞局灶CD34阳性，CK、Desmin和S-100阴性。病例未报告SOX10、ER或PR结果；讨论中的其他肿瘤表型不是本例检测结果。
text.en: Spindle cells show focal CD34 positivity and negative CK, desmin and S-100. SOX10, ER and PR are not reported for this patient; comparator tumour profiles in the discussion are not patient results.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 记录已手术切除肿物并送病理；未列切缘状态、完整切除的组织学确认或术前影像。
text.en: Excision and submission to pathology are documented; margin status, histological confirmation of complete removal and preoperative imaging are not given.

source.zh-CN: 原报告正文的去标识化摘要；对话措辞为教学改写。

text.zh-CN: 原报告明确术后随访6年，未见局部复发或转移；没有提供每次随访方式、切缘复核或系统性综合征筛查。6年良好结局属于本例事实，不代表所有类似病变不需随访。
text.en: The report explicitly states six years of postoperative follow-up without recurrence or metastasis. Visit methods, margin review and systematic syndrome screening are not detailed. This favourable six-year outcome is case-specific and does not remove the need for follow-up in other patients.

prompt.zh-CN: 形态和免疫组化共同支持什么？
prompt.en: What is supported by morphology and immunohistochemistry together?

need.zh-CN: 先采集相关病史并调阅此阶段的关键检查。
need.en: First obtain the relevant history and retrieve the key records for this phase.

text.zh-CN: 浅表性血管黏液瘤；根据本例证据保留鉴别范围
text.en: Superficial angiomyxoma, while respecting the limits of this case’s differential evidence

feedback.zh-CN: 浅表部位、黏液基质、血管、梭形细胞与免疫组合需共同解释，单一CD34标记不特异。
feedback.en: Superficial location, myxoid matrix, vessels, spindle cells and the immunopanel must be integrated; CD34 alone is nonspecific.

text.zh-CN: CD34阳性本身即可诊断侵袭性血管黏液瘤或肉瘤
text.en: CD34 positivity alone establishes aggressive angiomyxoma or sarcoma

feedback.zh-CN: 浅表部位、黏液基质、血管、梭形细胞与免疫组合需共同解释，单一CD34标记不特异。
feedback.en: Superficial location, myxoid matrix, vessels, spindle cells and the immunopanel must be integrated; CD34 alone is nonspecific.

prompt.zh-CN: 怎样形成随访计划而不补造已完成的检查？
prompt.en: How should follow-up be planned without inventing completed assessments?

need.zh-CN: 先采集相关病史并调阅此阶段的关键检查。
need.en: First obtain the relevant history and retrieve the key records for this phase.

text.zh-CN: 核实切缘与切除范围，安排局部复发随访；若出现多发病灶或相关体征，再针对性评估综合征线索
text.en: Confirm margins and extent of excision, plan local recurrence surveillance and evaluate syndromic clues if multiple lesions or relevant signs emerge

feedback.zh-CN: 本例切缘和综合征筛查未记录；不完整切除有复发风险，但单个肿物不能确证综合征。
feedback.en: Margins and syndromic screening are not documented; incomplete excision may recur, but one lesion does not establish a syndrome.

text.zh-CN: 病理为良性就不需随访，并据一处肿物直接确诊Carney综合征
text.en: A benign label removes the need for follow-up and a single lesion directly proves Carney complex

feedback.zh-CN: 本例切缘和综合征筛查未记录；不完整切除有复发风险，但单个肿物不能确证综合征。
feedback.en: Margins and syndromic screening are not documented; incomplete excision may recur, but one lesion does not establish a syndrome.

text.zh-CN: 重建症状与用药时间线
text.en: Reconstruct the symptom and medication timeline

text.zh-CN: 形成安全计划并复盘转归
text.en: Form a safe plan and review the outcome

knowledge.zh-CN: 这是历史病例教学。先核对当前阶段原始证据，再讨论鉴别诊断及安全计划；原报告处置不自动成为今天的推荐。
knowledge.en: This is a historical teaching case. Review evidence for the current phase before discussing differential diagnosis and a safe plan; reported care is not automatically a recommendation for current practice.

conclusion.zh-CN: 切除标本形态和免疫组合支持浅表性血管黏液瘤；本例6年未复发，未记录的切缘或综合征检查仍未知。
conclusion.en: Specimen morphology and immunophenotype support superficial angiomyxoma; no recurrence was reported over six years, while undocumented margin and syndrome assessments remain unknown.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 患者实测免疫组化与讨论中的典型表型要分开。
keyReasoning.en: Separate the patient’s actual immunostains from typical comparator profiles in the discussion.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: “其他检查未见异常”不能扩大成未列项目均阴性。
keyReasoning.en: “Other examinations unremarkable” must not be expanded into negative results for unspecified tests.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单例观察，不能证明某种治疗的独立疗效或普遍适用性。历史处置仅记录事实；安全决策为教学设计。
boundaries.en: This single observation cannot establish the independent efficacy or general applicability of a treatment. Historical care is recorded as fact; safety decisions are educational design.

unknowns.zh-CN: 切缘状态、术前影像、系统皮肤/内分泌评估及具体随访方法。
unknowns.en: Margin status, preoperative imaging, systematic skin/endocrine evaluation and follow-up methods.

notice.zh-CN: 评分衡量完成本教学路径的程度，未经临床能力评价验证。
notice.en: Scores measure completion of this teaching pathway and are not validated measures of clinical competence.
